scope: U18A bounded frozen-corpus shadow/prevalence evidence and R94A activation record; no provider calls, application database writes, or runtime activation.

lexical_topic_proxies.normalization: lower(concat_ws(' ', text, text_en, text_zh_cn)); PostgreSQL case-insensitive regex (~*)
lexical_topic_proxies.interpretation: These are broad lexical screens, not U18A labels, precision estimates, recall estimates, or model-quality measurements. A post may match multiple proxies.

investigate_claim.interpretation: The tight screen is a lexical upper-bound proxy; the generic allegation screen is too noisy to stand in for the product label.

repeated_promoter_proxies.brand_discovery_candidates_note: No persisted BrandDiscoveryCandidate rows existed in the read-only frozen database; this report therefore supplies no population estimate for novel promoted-brand identities.

candidate_quality.scope: R94A source-visible agent audit, not human gold, not population accuracy, and not a runtime reviewer call.
candidate_quality.quality_interpretation: Unsupported expected assignments are comparator failures against the frozen source-visible expected field. They are not independently verified false-positive/false-negative rates and do not measure the frozen database population. The activation floor is at most one unsupported case in each positive and negative/boundary set.

false_positive_pressure.interpretation: Source-visible hard negatives from the frozen evaluator. Most unsupported negative rows were mechanically incomplete, so these are pressure cases rather than observed candidate or population false positives.

cases.text: MiniMax’s office rent increased; no model cost or product performance is discussed.
MiniMax is impressive; generic praise is not an evaluation or benchmark.
MiniMax opened a new office; “opened” is not an openness or licensing claim.
MiniMax hired a talent agent; that employment role is not an AI agent/tool topic.
I think MiniMax will release a better model next year; this is a prediction, not reporting.
MiniMax is worse than its rival; ordinary opinion is not a consequential investigate-claim.
MiniMax is based in China; nationality alone is not geopolitical mode or nationalism.
MiniMax’s official account promotes MiniMax H3; a tracked brand’s own promotion is not an untracked-brand promotion.

prompt_bytes.measurement: UTF-8 system prompt plus compact JSON user payload, representative 20-case family; system prompt is fixed by role, user payload varies by case text/context/catalog.

activation.user_facing_filter_rule: Only enabled gates may appear as active filters or valid query dimensions; shadow-only values remain unavailable and stale links must be canonicalized as unavailable.
activation.decision_basis: R94A per-family source-visible audit floor; owner-selected model route override is separate from family activation quality decisions.

limitations: Lexical proxies use broad multilingual regexes over stored source/English/Chinese text and therefore include false positives, miss paraphrases, and overcount generic words such as cost, performance, test, API, and open.
The frozen classifier labels predate U18A and are not a gold set. Historical labels, legacy flags, and role/account relationships cannot establish U18A precision or recall.
Synthetic audit fixtures fill rare predicates and matched boundaries; their results must not be projected to production prevalence.

The R94A evaluator was source-visible and provider-free; its expected decisions are an agent audit contract, not human adjudication. Candidate unsupported counts are comparator evidence, not population accuracy.
Frozen-corpus rates are time-concentrated and are not a forward forecast. BrandDiscoveryCandidate had no rows in this dump, so novel-brand identity recurrence is not estimated.
Media screens are structural upper bounds; only the 100-row exploratory review supplied an agent-assessed dependency signal.
The report records the owner's activation decision for three families and eight shadow-only gates; it does not claim the shadow-only gates are solved or production-ready.
